response.justification: The candidate is a strong and versatile senior engineer, but their profile is fundamentally misaligned with this role. C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a thesis project, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. There is no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital is retail fintech, not capital markets), and no SQL Server/Oracle exposure is evidenced. The bulk of their career is web/full-stack work in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang.
strengths: Deep systems/performance engineering background (low-latency, async I/O, high-throughput services)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, DevOps tooling
Broad polyglot experience with demonstrated ability to pick up new stacks quickly
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, nearly a decade ago, and not Windows-focused
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience (SQL listed only generically, mainly MongoDB/MySQL)

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain expertise
Strong general engineering fundamentals and performance systems work
